questions.question: A form of government characterized by rampant corruption, where leaders exploit national resources for personal gain.
questions.solution:
Kleptocracy is government marked by rampant corruption where leaders loot national resources. Plutocracy is rule by the wealthy. Oligarchy is rule by a small group. Autocracy is rule by one absolute ruler.

🎯 Target Word: Kleptocracy
